schemes.BasicAuth.description: "**⚠\u{fe0f} DEPRECATED** — Basic authentication (username/password) is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use `POST /v2/api/token/auth` to obtain a Bearer token instead.\n"
schemes.Bearer.description: "JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Obtain a token via `POST /v2/api/token/auth`."

schemes.LegacyTokenAuth.description: "**⚠\u{fe0f} DEPRECATED** — Legacy token authentication via the `x-compass-token` header is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use `POST /v2/api/token/auth` to obtain a Bearer token, or `POST /v2/api/token/auth/refresh` to refresh an existing token.\n"
